blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Akbayan party-list Rep. Percival Cendaña has called for the passage of their bill which seeks stronger protection of animals, after reports on the dumping of 29 dead pets’ remains in the City of San Jose del Monte, Bulacan. In a statement on Saturday, Cendaña called for the passage of House Bill (HB) No. 11495 or the proposed Animal Life Advocacy and Guardianship Act (ALAGA), after netizens and different organizations sounded the alarm on the dumping of 29 pets in a vacant lot in the said city. “Nakakalungkot at nakakagalit itong ganitong ginawang pag tapon sa labi ng mga […]...
